01 · 先看懂约束和内积01 · Read the constraint and inner product

Lecture 2 · pp.4, 6–8 / textbook A.1.1–A.1.3

学完应能：区分约束里的 x 与固定的 z，读懂单位球。After studying: distinguish the variable x from the fixed z, and understand the unit ball.

速通 · 长度与可行向量Quick · Length and feasible vectors 当前层新增Added at this level

设 x,z 都是 n 维列向量。固定 z，允许 x 改变。约束 限制 x 的长度；目标 测量它沿 z 的线性响应。Let x and z be n-dimensional column vectors. Fix z and vary x. The constraint limits the length of x; the objective measures its linear response in direction z.

满足绝对齐次性，所以缩放 x 会按同样比例缩放长度。中的球形状取决于所选范数。A is absolutely homogeneous, so scaling x scales its length by the same factor. The shape of the depends on the norm.

了解 · 一份资源预算，三种分配方式Understand · Three ways to allocate a length budget 当前层新增Added at this level

二维 单位球要求 |x₁|+|x₂|≤1，像总预算； 单位球要求每个 |xᵢ|≤1，每个坐标各有预算； 单位球要求 x₁²+x₂²≤1，像总能量预算。The two-dimensional ball imposes |x₁|+|x₂|≤1, a shared budget. The ball imposes |xᵢ|≤1 for each coordinate, separate budgets. The ball imposes x₁²+x₂²≤1, an energy budget.

例如 z=(3,−2)，内积为 3x₁−2x₂。增加 x₁ 和减小 x₂ 都能提高目标；但可走多远由单位球决定。这里 z 是系数，x 是要选择的向量。For z=(3,−2), the inner product is 3x₁−2x₂. Increasing x₁ and decreasing x₂ both improve the objective, while the unit ball limits how far we may go. The vector z supplies coefficients; x is the vector being chosen.

02 · 对偶范数的定义02 · Definition of the dual norm

Lecture 2 · p.13 / textbook A.1.6 · printed pp.636–637 / PDF pp.650–651

学完应能：用“可行集＋最大线性响应”解释星号。After studying: interpret the star through a feasible set and its largest linear response.

速通 · 固定 z，对 x 取上确界Quick · Fix z and take the supremum over x 当前层新增Added at this level

定义如下。星号标记“原范数对应的对偶”；求值时输入的是 z，优化变量是 x。The is defined below. The star denotes the dual associated with the primal norm. Its input is z; its optimization variable is x.

记号 是 supremum 的缩写。当前有限维范数单位球闭且有界，连续函数在其上能取到 ，因此这里也可写 max。The notation abbreviates supremum. In finite dimensions the norm unit ball is closed and bounded, and a continuous function attains a on it, so max is also valid here.

了解 · 让直线向外移动，直到恰好接触Understand · Move a line outwards until it touches 当前层新增Added at this level

二维中， 是一条法向为 z 的直线。把 c 增大，直线向 z 的方向移动；它最后还能接触单位球时的 c，就是对偶范数。对偶范数也是单位球的 。In two dimensions, is a line with normal z. Increasing c moves it in direction z. The last value of c at which the line still touches the unit ball is the dual norm. It is also the of the unit ball.

图中 z 的欧氏长度固定为 1。蓝箭头是 z；红点是一个最大化点；实线为当前直线，虚线为最优支撑直线。把位置滑块调到 1，观察接触；大于 1 时直线不再与球相交。直线沿法向 z 移动，图中法向也明确画出。The Euclidean length of z is fixed at one. The blue arrow shows z; the red point is a maximizer. The solid line is the current line and the dashed line is the optimal supporting line. Set the position slider to one to observe contact. Above one the line no longer intersects the ball. The line moves along its normal z, which is shown explicitly.

为什么目标没写绝对值？单位球关于原点对称：若 x 可行，−x 也可行。负内积翻转符号后变正，故两种上确界相同。z=0 时目标处处为 0。Why is there no absolute value? The unit ball is symmetric about the origin: if x is feasible, so is −x. A negative inner product can be made positive by changing the sign of x. Thus the two suprema agree. For z=0 the objective is zero everywhere.

03 · 三组常用对偶03 · Three standard dual pairs

Lecture 2 · pp.14–16 / textbook A.1.6

学完应能：解释 ℓ₁/ℓ∞ 的配对，并检查上界能否取得。After studying: explain the ℓ₁/ℓ∞ pairing and verify that each bound is attained.

速通 · 配对表Quick · The pairs 当前层新增Added at this level

原范数Primal norm对应的对偶范数Associated dual normz=(3,−2) 的值Value at z=(3,−2)
ℓ₁ℓ∞3
ℓ₂ℓ₂√13 ≈ 3.606
ℓ∞ℓ₁5

先检查原约束用的是哪一个范数，再读取对偶配对。写成 时，星号总是相对于当前指定的原范数。Identify the norm in the primal constraint before choosing a dual pair. The notation is always relative to the specified primal norm.

了解 · 预算决定最大响应Understand · The budget determines the response 当前层新增Added at this level

ℓ₁ 把总预算限制为 1，应把预算投给绝对值最大的系数，因此得到 max |zᵢ|。ℓ∞ 让每个坐标都可用 ±1，各坐标可同时贡献 |zᵢ|，因此得到总和。ℓ₂ 的圆球则沿 z 的方向取得最大值。The ℓ₁ constraint limits the total budget to one, so it is allocated to a coefficient with largest absolute value, giving max |zᵢ|. Under ℓ∞ each coordinate can independently be ±1, so all coordinates contribute |zᵢ| at once, giving their sum. The Euclidean ball is maximized in direction z.

同一个 z 的三个数不同，是因为可行球不同。只背“ℓ₂ 自对偶”无法解释 ℓ₁ 与 ℓ∞；应回到定义里的预算约束。The three values differ for the same z because the feasible balls differ. The ℓ₁/ℓ∞ pair is best understood by returning to the budget constraint in the definition.

掌握 · 每次都证明上界，再给取等点Mastery · Bound first, then attain it 当前层新增Added at this level

① 原范数 ℓ₂① Primal norm ℓ₂

用 得到上界。若 z≠0，选 x*=z/‖z‖₂；它可行且内积等于上界。若 z=0，选 x=0。Apply the to obtain an upper bound. For z≠0, choose x*=z/‖z‖₂; it is feasible and its inner product equals the bound. For z=0, take x=0.

② 原范数 ℓ∞② Primal norm ℓ∞

选 xᵢ*=sgn(zᵢ)。sgn 表示 sign function（符号函数）：正数为 1，负数为 −1，零为 0。每个 |xᵢ*|≤1，并且每一项 zᵢxᵢ*=|zᵢ|。Choose xᵢ*=sgn(zᵢ). Here sgn denotes the sign function（符号函数）: 1 for positive values, −1 for negative values and 0 at zero. Each |xᵢ*|≤1 and each product zᵢxᵢ*=|zᵢ|.

③ 原范数 ℓ₁③ Primal norm ℓ₁

取某个 k 满足 |zₖ|=‖z‖∞，令 x*=sgn(zₖ)eₖ。eₖ 为第 k 个标准基向量，仅第 k 个分量为 1。若 z=0 则直接选 x=0。存在并列最大坐标时最大化点可能不唯一。Choose any k with |zₖ|=‖z‖∞ and let x*=sgn(zₖ)eₖ. The standard basis vector eₖ has one in position k and zeros elsewhere. For z=0, choose x=0. Tied largest coordinates can give multiple maximizers.

证明“≤候选值”只能得到上界。还要展示可行向量达到候选值，才能把 supremum 算出来。Proving “≤ candidate value” only establishes an upper bound. A feasible vector attaining the candidate value completes the calculation of the supremum.

04 · 归一化得到通用内积界04 · Normalize to obtain the general bound

Lecture 2 · p.13 / textbook A.1.6

学完应能：解释归一化的理由，并单独处理零向量。After studying: explain normalization and treat the zero vector separately.

速通 · 通用公式Quick · The general inequality 当前层新增Added at this level

右侧一个原范数、一个对应对偶范数。若两者都随意选 ℓ₁ 或 ℓ∞，就需要重新证明。The right side uses a primal norm and its associated dual norm. Arbitrarily substituting two norms would require a new proof.

了解 · 把任意长度缩到单位球Understand · Rescale any length into the unit ball 当前层新增Added at this level

当 x≠0 时，把 x 除以自己的长度，得到单位长度向量。这个向量属于定义里的可行集，所以它对 z 的响应不会超过对偶范数。最后乘回原长度。For x≠0, divide x by its own norm to obtain a unit vector. This vector belongs to the feasible set in the definition, so its response to z cannot exceed the dual norm. Multiply back by the original length.

掌握 · 四行证明Mastery · A four-line proof 当前层新增Added at this level

以上以 x≠0 为前提。x=0 时左右两边均为零，不做除法。省去零情形会使证明在一处没有定义。The calculation assumes x≠0. When x=0, both sides are zero and no division is performed. Omitting this case leaves one step undefined.

05 · 二次范数：把椭圆变成圆05 · Quadratic norms: turn an ellipse into a circle

Lecture 2 · p.8, pp.13–16 / textbook A.1.3, A.1.6, A.5.2 / HW1 · 1(a)

学完应能：通过换元求二次范数的对偶，验证最优向量。After studying: derive the quadratic dual norm by a change of variables and verify a maximizer.

速通 · 结论与条件Quick · Result and assumptions 当前层新增Added at this level

设 P 是实对称 。原 为 。它在标准内积下的对偶是由 P⁻¹ 定义的二次范数。Let P be a real symmetric . The primal is . Its dual under the standard inner product is the quadratic norm defined by P⁻¹.

P≻0 同时保证原式是范数、P 可逆、矩阵平方根存在。只有 时，式子可能是半范数，某些方向的上确界会无穷大。The assumption P≻0 makes the primal expression a norm, ensures invertibility and supplies a positive definite square root. With only a , the expression may be a seminorm and the supremum may be infinite in some directions.

了解 · 大权重让原方向更贵Understand · Larger weights make primal motion costly 当前层新增Added at this level

若 P=diag(p₁,p₂)，约束是 p₁x₁²+p₂x₂²≤1，单位球是 。p₁ 增大时，第一轴半径 1/√p₁ 缩小，x₁ 能贡献的响应减少；对应的对偶公式使用倒数权重。For P=diag(p₁,p₂), the constraint is p₁x₁²+p₂x₂²≤1 and the unit ball is an . Increasing p₁ shrinks the first-axis radius 1/√p₁, reducing the response that x₁ can contribute. The dual formula accordingly uses reciprocal weights.

图中 z 的欧氏长度为 1，蓝箭头指 z，红箭头指 x*。除非椭圆对该方向恰好各向同性，最优 x* 通常与 z 不平行。支撑直线的法向仍为 z。这里只画对角 P；一般正定 P 还会旋转椭圆。The vector z has Euclidean length one. The blue arrow indicates z and the red arrow indicates x*. Unless the ellipse is isotropic in that direction, x* generally is not parallel to z. The supporting line still has normal z. This experiment uses diagonal P; a general positive definite P can also rotate the ellipse.

掌握 · 换元、上界、取等Mastery · Transform, bound, attain 当前层新增Added at this level

第 1 步：让约束变成欧氏单位球Step 1: transform the constraint into a Euclidean unit ball

正定 P 有唯一正定 。取 u=P½x，反解 x=P⁻½u。由于平方根对称，目标中的转置可以写为 P⁻½z。A positive definite P has a unique positive definite . Set u=P½x, so x=P⁻½u. Symmetry of the square root converts the transformed objective into an inner product with P⁻½z.

第 2 步：应用欧氏对偶结果Step 2: use the Euclidean dual result

第 3 步：把取等向量变回 xStep 3: transform the equality vector back to x

若 z≠0，令 d=√(zᵀP⁻¹z)>0。在圆球里取 u*=P⁻½z/d，换回 x 后得到下式。For z≠0, let d=√(zᵀP⁻¹z)>0. In the Euclidean ball choose u*=P⁻½z/d, then transform back to obtain:

第 4 步：直接核对可行性与目标Step 4: check feasibility and objective directly

若 z=0，d=0，不能使用分母公式；选 x=0 即可，上确界为 0。正定 P 且 z≠0 时，椭圆严格凸，最大化点唯一。For z=0 we have d=0, so the quotient formula is undefined. Choose x=0; the supremum is zero. For positive definite P and nonzero z, strict convexity of the ellipsoid gives a unique maximizer.

作业 1(a) 的证明骨架到这里已齐全。写作时保留：P≻0 的用途、换元、Cauchy–Schwarz 上界、取等点、z=0。The proof framework needed for HW1 1(a) is now complete. Include the role of P≻0, the substitution, the Cauchy–Schwarz upper bound, an attaining vector and the z=0 case.

掌握 · 手算一个独立例子Mastery · Work a numerical example 当前层新增Added at this level

若误用 z/‖z‖₂=(2,1)/√5，原约束左侧为 17/5>1，根本不可行。这个例子同时检查了公式、取等和“直接沿 z”的错误。If one incorrectly uses z/‖z‖₂=(2,1)/√5, the primal constraint evaluates to 17/5>1, so the vector is infeasible. This example checks the formula, attainment and the incorrect choice of moving directly along z.

深入 · 半正定为何会失败In depth · What fails for a semidefinite P 当前层新增Added at this level

取 P=diag(1,0)，约束只限制 |x₁|≤1，x₂ 没有长度代价。若 z=(0,1)，令 x₂→+∞，内积无界；P⁻¹ 也不存在。若 z 在 P 的值域内，受约束部分可用伪逆分析，但这已超出作业的正定前提。For P=diag(1,0), the constraint only bounds |x₁|≤1; x₂ carries no cost. With z=(0,1), letting x₂→+∞ makes the objective unbounded, and P⁻¹ does not exist. When z lies in the range of P, the constrained part can be analyzed using a pseudoinverse, beyond the positive definite assumptions of the homework.

核对 ACheck A

提示 1：先反转权重Hint 1: invert the weights

P⁻¹=diag(1/9,1/4)。先算 zᵀP⁻¹z，再开平方。P⁻¹=diag(1/9,1/4). First evaluate zᵀP⁻¹z, then take the square root.

深入 · 一般 ℓp：Hölder 上界和取等In depth · General ℓp: Hölder bound and attainment 当前层新增Added at this level

当 1Hölder 不等式Hölder inequality 给上界。对 z≠0，以下取等向量把上界变为精确值。For 1Hölder 不等式Hölder inequality gives the bound. For z≠0 the following attaining vector makes that bound exact.

这里 (q−1)p=q。端点 p=1 和 p=∞ 分别对应 q=∞ 和 q=1，使用第 3 节的取等构造；不要把含 q−1 的表达式机械代入无穷。Here (q−1)p=q. The endpoints p=1 and p=∞ correspond to q=∞ and q=1 respectively; use the attaining constructions from Section 3 rather than substituting infinity mechanically.

深入 · 矩阵的 ℓ₂ 与核范数In depth · Matrix ℓ₂ and the nuclear norm 当前层新增Added at this level

矩阵使用迹内积 。 的对偶为 ，并非仍为谱范数。 则自对偶。课件的矩阵 ℓ₂ 指谱范数；向量 ℓ₂ 才直接指欧氏长度。Matrices use the trace inner product . The dual of the is the . The is self-dual. In the slide, matrix ℓ₂ denotes the spectral norm, whereas vector ℓ₂ denotes Euclidean length.

用 写 Z=UΣVᵀ。对任意 ‖X‖₂≤1，每项 |uᵢᵀXvᵢ|≤1，故迹内积≤Σσᵢ；取 X=UVᵀ（薄分解）可取等。Z=0 时选 X=0。Using the , write Z=UΣVᵀ. For ‖X‖₂≤1, each |uᵢᵀXvᵢ|≤1, so the trace inner product is at most Σσᵢ. The choice X=UVᵀ from a thin decomposition attains it. When Z=0 take X=0.

例如 Z=diag(3,2)：谱范数为 3，Frobenius 范数为 √13，核范数为 5。这三个量对应不同定义。For Z=diag(3,2), the spectral norm is 3, the Frobenius norm is √13 and the nuclear norm is 5. These are distinct definitions.

深入 · 双重对偶、锥与共轭In depth · Biduality, cones and conjugacy 当前层新增Added at this level

对偶单位球等于原单位球 B 的 。有限维中 B 是闭、凸、含原点的集合，极集取两次回到 B，从而原范数的双重对偶等于原范数。这个结论依赖有限维闭凸几何，不能无条件推广到任意空间。The dual unit ball is the of the primal ball B. In finite dimensions B is closed, convex and contains the origin, so taking its polar twice returns B and the bidual norm equals the primal norm. This relies on the stated finite-dimensional geometry.

对于范数锥 K={(x,t):‖x‖≤t}，标准内积下的对偶锥为 K*={(z,s):‖z‖*≤s}。欧氏范数自对偶，因而 自对偶；这连接作业 5(b)。For the norm cone K={(x,t):‖x‖≤t}, the dual cone under the standard inner product is K*={(z,s):‖z‖*≤s}. The Euclidean norm is self-dual, so the is self-dual, connecting this chapter to HW1 5(b).

若 f(x)=‖x‖，其 是对偶单位球的示性函数。示性函数在集合内为 0，在集合外为 +∞。范数的星号、锥的星号和函数的星号作用在不同对象上。For f(x)=‖x‖, its is the indicator function of the dual unit ball: zero inside and +∞ outside. The stars for norms, cones and functions act on different objects.

第一种情形由通用内积界得目标≤0，x=0 取等。第二种情形选择 ‖u‖≤1 且 zᵀu>1，再取 x=tu，t→∞，目标无界。In the first case the general bound gives an objective at most zero, attained at x=0. In the second choose ‖u‖≤1 with zᵀu>1 and set x=tu. The objective diverges as t→∞.

norm‖x‖满足非负、正定、绝对齐次和三角不等式的长度度量。A length measure satisfying nonnegativity, definiteness, absolute homogeneity and the triangle inequality.回到讲解Go to section
unit ballB所有长度不超过 1 的向量；本章使用闭单位球。The set of vectors whose norm is at most one; the closed unit ball is used here.回到讲解Go to section
inner productzᵀx这里用标准内积：对应分量乘积之和。Here the standard inner product is the sum of componentwise products.回到讲解Go to section
supremumsup所有上界中最小的一个；未必由某点取到。The least upper bound; it need not be attained.回到讲解Go to section
maximummax由可行集中某点实际取得的最大函数值。The largest value actually attained at a feasible point.回到讲解Go to section
dual norm‖z‖*在原范数单位球上，线性函数 zᵀx 能取得的最大值。The maximum of the linear function zᵀx over the primal unit ball.回到讲解Go to section
support functionh_B(z)给定集合 B 和方向 z，取 sup{x∈B} zᵀx。For a set B and direction z, the supremum of zᵀx over B.回到讲解Go to section
Hölder inequality1/p+1/q=1共轭指数对应的内积界：|zᵀx|≤‖x‖p‖z‖q。An inner-product bound for conjugate exponents: |zᵀx|≤‖x‖p‖z‖q.回到讲解Go to section

positive definite matrixP≻0 / PDPD = Positive Definite，正定；实对称 P 对每个非零 x 满足 xᵀPx>0。PD = Positive Definite（正定）; a real symmetric P satisfies xᵀPx>0 for every nonzero x.回到讲解Go to section
positive semidefinite matrixP⪰0 / PSDPSD = Positive Semidefinite，半正定；实对称 P 对所有 x 满足 xᵀPx≥0。PSD = Positive Semidefinite（半正定）; a real symmetric P satisfies xᵀPx≥0 for every x.回到讲解Go to section
quadratic norm‖x‖P由正定矩阵 P 定义的 √(xᵀPx)。The norm √(xᵀPx) defined by a positive definite matrix P.回到讲解Go to section
matrix square rootP½正定 P 有唯一正定平方根；特征值取正平方根。A positive definite P has a unique positive definite square root, formed from positive square roots of its eigenvalues.回到讲解Go to section
